about.overview: We take your dreams and ideas, and transport them into a world where impressions last. We specialise in creating every conceivable possibility with Plastics and Cardboards, through our UV Printing & Packaging capabilities. Specialising in UV offset printing enables us to print onto a wide variety of substrates with inks that dry & adhere instantaneously.

before.title: Specialist Printers of Plastic & Cardboard Products - Permanent Press

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: Not served over HTTPS
issues.evidence: Final URL is http://www.permanentpress.co.nz/. Browsers label this site "Not secure".

issues.title: No easy way to get in touch
issues.evidence: No tap-to-call link and no enquiry form on the homepage.

issues.title: No local-business search markup
issues.evidence: No structured data, so Google has less to show for the business.
